caption: The worked example as a pipeline: 227×227×3 in, 96 filters of 11×11 with stride 4 out, giving 55×55×96 — one map per filter. A 3×3 max pool with stride 2 then halves each side to 27×27×96, and the whole layer is only 34,944 weights because each filter is reused at every position.

spec.title: AlexNet layer 1
spec.aria: A 227 by 227 by 3 image goes through 96 filters of 11 by 11 with stride 4 to give 55 by 55 by 96, then a 3 by 3 max pool with stride 2 gives 27 by 27 by 96; the layer holds 34,944 weights.
